description: Source code for managing and running agent nodes, including process management, port allocation, environment setup, and capability display.

classes.name: AgentNodeRunner
classes.description: Handles running agent nodes, process management, environment setup, and capability display.

methods.name: RunAgentNode
methods.description: Starts an installed agent node, manages process, updates registry, and displays capabilities.

methods.name: getFreePort
methods.description: Finds an available port in the range 8001-8999.

methods.name: isPortAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is available.

methods.name: startAgentNodeProcess
methods.description: Starts the agent node process with environment variables and logging.

methods.name: waitForAgentNode
methods.description: Waits until the agent node is ready by polling its health endpoint.

methods.name: displayCapabilities
methods.description: Fetches and displays agent node's reasoners and skills.

methods.name: updateRuntimeInfo
methods.description: Updates the registry with runtime info such as port, PID, and start time.

methods.name: loadRegistry
methods.description: Loads the installation registry from YAML file.

methods.name: loadPackageEnvFile
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a package's .env file.
